properties.name: WHAT WORKED (2026-10-02, 0.77.0): `--call describe_schema` with node_type serves every property's enum values. At the default budget it withholds only prose and says so, and a large budget_chars returns the full text. It is the door agent's one served source of value sets before a write. Do not regress it
properties.statement:
From art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02, measured table row "`--call describe_schema` with `node_type` and a large `budget_chars` | full property list with enum values; the default budget withholds the prose", and the working pattern "Learn enums before writing".

Re-measured by triage agent B on 0.77.0 (scratch import of main's export), node_type TemporalFact:
- At the default budget, budget.applied is true and full_chars is 51,165 against 30,000. "WITHHELD TO FIT … What was withheld is PROSE: 83 text field(s)". All 27 `values` lists stay.
- With budget_chars 200000 the full text comes back and no budget block.
- It served TemporalFact.basis = [measured, forecast], which answers one of the report's frictions before the call.

LIMIT, recorded so nobody reads this as complete: it describes NODE and EDGE types, not a tool's arguments. Nested argument shapes and a dual-mode constructor's create-time fields are not in it. For DesignEpoch, required_only names only `name`, while add_epoch also needs sequence and epoch_type (fact:add-epoch-create-requirements-are-published-nowhere-and-describe-schema-says-only-name-is-required-2026-10-02).
